title: Credits background loader retains an unused byte argument
claim: Credits_Init preserves its byte argument for the call to Credits_LoadBgGfx, and Screen_FadeSequence explicitly passes zero. The loader does not read the incoming argument. The shared void(u8) interface preserves caller and callee code; choosing void(void) from the old definition would discard caller evidence.

title: Interior table anchors preserve group-update loop shape
claim: The updater at 08029710 loads the 08317a60 pointer-table window directly. Indexing the parent table as base[i+5] produced an extra addition and a four-byte larger function; a linker-relative alias at parent+0x14 preserves the direct anchor and matches. The adjacent 08029748 updater uses parent+0x4c. These aliases clarify existing data ownership and do not reconstruct the underlying INCBIN table.

title: DMA frame cycling uses a typed sixteen-byte aggregate
claim: The callee homes r0-r3 and reads a u16 frame count at +0, u8 delay at +2, source-table pointer at +4, destination pointer at +8 and u16 byte count at +12. Twelve immutable-ROM callsites load the four words; all eight compiled callsites now use the shared by-value type. The 08308100 configuration is an explicit 16-byte C initializer. Its 0x480 byte count is divided by two for DMA halfword transfers.

title: Typed DMA state closes the historical eight-byte residual
claim: The audited aggregate with the old raw byte-pointer state still differed by eight bytes over six instructions. Using the existing ScrollBlitLayer global and its lastTick/animFrame members, together with the pointer-typed source table, produces the exact 136-byte function without pins or assembly barriers. A clean integrated ROM check passes. The exact internal allocation-pass explanation remains uninstrumented; the historical residual is not an impossibility result.
